lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣੀ ਚਲਉ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: charanee chalau maarag thaakur kai rasanaa har gun gaae ||2||
lines.translation: With my feet, I walk on my Lord and Mater's Path. With my tongue, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿਓ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਰਬ ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ ਉਲਟੀ ਸੰਤ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: dekhio drisat sarab ma(n)gal roop ulatee sa(n)t karaae ||
lines.translation: With my eyes, I see the Lord, the Embodiment of Absolute Bliss; the Saint has turned away from the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਓ ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: paaio laal amol naam har chhod na katahoo jaae ||3||
lines.translation: I have found the Priceless Name of the Beloved Lord; it never leaves me or goes anywhere else. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਉਨ ਬਡਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਨ ਕਹਉ ਰੀਝਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kavan upamaa kaun badaaee kiaa gun kahau reejhaae ||
lines.translation: What praise, what glory and what virtues should I utter, in order to please the Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਏ ॥੪॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: hot kripaal deen daiaa prabh jan naanak daas dasaae ||4||8||
lines.translation: That humble being, unto whom the Merciful Lord is kind - O servant Nanak, he is the slave of God's slaves. ||4||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਓੁਇ ਸੁਖ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਬਰਨਿ ਸੁਨਾਵਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: oui sukh kaa siu baran sunaavat ||
lines.translation: Who can I tell, and with whom can I speak, about this state of peace and bliss?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anad binod pekh prabh darasan man ma(n)gal gun gaavat ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am in ecstasy and delight, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. My mind sings His Songs of Joy and His Glories. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮ ਭਈ ਪੇਖਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਕਿਰਪਾਵਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: bisam bhaee pekh bisamaadee poor rahe kirapaavat ||
lines.translation: I am wonderstruck, gazing upon the Wondrous Lord. The Merciful Lord is All-pervading everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੀਓ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਖਿ ਗੂੰਗਾ ਮੁਸਕਾਵਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: peeo a(n)mrit naam amolak jiu chaakh goo(n)gaa musakaavat ||1||
lines.translation: I drink in the Invaluable Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Like the mute, I can only smile - I cannot speak of its flavor. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਬੰਧ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਵਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaise pavan ba(n)dh kar raakhio boojh na aavat jaavat ||
lines.translation: As the breath is held in bondage, no one can understand its coming in and going out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਉਆ ਕੀ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਹਾਵਤ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau ridai pragaas bhaio har uaa kee kahee na jaai kahaavat ||2||
lines.translation: So is that person, whose heart is enlightened by the Lord - his story cannot be told. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਤੇਤੇ ਸੀਖੇ ਪਾਵਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: aan upaav jete kichh kaheeahi tete seekhe paavat ||
lines.translation: As many other efforts as you can think of - I have seen them and studied them all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਲਾਲੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਅਗਮ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਖਾਵਤ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: achi(n)t laal grih bheetar pragatio agam jaise parakhaavat ||3||
lines.translation: My Beloved, Carefree Lord has revealed Himself within the home of my own heart; thus I have realized the Inaccessible Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਤੁਲੋ ਤੁਲਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਵਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: niragun nira(n)kaar abinaasee atulo tulio na jaavat ||
lines.translation: The Absolute, Formless, Eternally Unchanging, Immeasurable Lord cannot be measured.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਰਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਵਤ ॥੪॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak ajar jin jariaa tis hee kau ban aavat ||4||9||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, whoever endures the unendurable - this state belongs to him alone. ||4||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਗੁਦਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikhaee din rain iv hee gudaarai ||
lines.translation: The corrupt person passes his days and nights uselessly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਨ ਭਜੈ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਜੂਐ ਜਿਉ ਹਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)d na bhajai aha(n)budh maataa janam jooai jiu haarai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He does not vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe; he is intoxicated with egotistical intellect. He loses his life in the gamble. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam amolaa preet na tis siu par ni(n)daa hitakaarai ||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is priceless, but he is not in love with it. He loves only to slander others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਾਪਰੁ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਸਵਾਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਕੋ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਜਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: chhaapar baa(n)dh savaarai trin ko duaarai paavak jaarai ||1||
lines.translation: Weaving the grass, he builds his house of straw. At the door, he builds a fire. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲਰ ਪੋਟ ਉਠਾਵੈ ਮੂੰਡਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਡਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaalar pot uthaavai moo(n)dahi a(n)mrit man te daarai ||
lines.translation: He carries a load of sulfur on his head, and drives the Ambrosial Nectar out of his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਢੈ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਾਜਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਝਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: odhai basatr kaajar mahi pariaa bahur bahur phir jhaarai ||2||
lines.translation: Wearing his good clothes, the mortal falls into the coal-pit; again and again, he tries to shake it off. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਟੈ ਪੇਡੁ ਡਾਲ ਪਰਿ ਠਾਢੌ ਖਾਇ ਖਾਇ ਮੁਸਕਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaatai ped daal par thaadhau khaai khaai musakaarai ||
lines.translation: Standing on the branch, eating and eating and smiling, he cuts down the tree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਰਿਓ ਜਾਇ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਛਿਟੀ ਛਿਟੀ ਸਿਰ ਭਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: girio jaai rasaatal pario chhitee chhitee sir bhaarai ||3||
lines.translation: He falls down head-first and is shattered into bits and pieces. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਵੈਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਰਚਾਏ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਗਵਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: niravairai sa(n)g vair rachaae pahuch na sakai gavaarai ||
lines.translation: He bears vengeance against the Lord who is free of vengeance. The fool is not up to the task.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak sa(n)tan kaa raakhaa paarabraham nira(n)kaarai ||4||10||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Saving Grace of the Saints is the Formless, Supreme Lord God. ||4||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: avar sabh bhoole bhramat na jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: All the others are deluded by doubt; they do not understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸੁਧਾਖਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਬੇਦਹਿ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek sudhaakhar jaa kai hiradai vasiaa tin bedahi tat pachhaaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: That person, within whose heart the One Pure Word abides, realizes the essence of the Vedas. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਜੇਤਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਈਐ ਤੇਤਾ ਲੋਗ ਪਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: paravirat maarag jetaa kichh hoeeai tetaa log pachaaraa ||
lines.translation: He walks in the ways of the world, trying to please people.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਲਉ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jau lau ridai nahee paragaasaa tau lau a(n)dh a(n)dhaaraa ||1||
lines.translation: But as long as his heart is not enlightened, he is stuck in pitch black darkness. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੀਜੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਂਮੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaise dharatee saadhai bahu bidh bin beejai nahee jaa(n)mai ||
lines.translation: The land may be prepared in every way, but nothing sprouts without being planted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na hoee hai tutai naahee abhimaanai ||2||
lines.translation: Just so, without the Lord's Name, no one is liberated, nor is egotistical pride eradicated. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਰੁ ਬਿਲੋਵੈ ਅਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਨੈਨੂ ਕੈਸੇ ਰੀਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: neer bilovai at sram paavai nainoo kaise reesai ||
lines.translation: The mortal may churn water until he is sore, but how can butter be produced?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਮਿਲਤ ਨਹੀ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur bhete mukat na kaahoo milat nahee jagadeesai ||3||
lines.translation: Without meeting the Guru, no one is liberated, and the Lord of the Universe is not met. ||3||
